findings.title: Research registers verified at assigned checkpoints
findings.description: 27 KR01, 16 KR02, 19 KR04 entries; all pending review. Counts refer to records, not validated discoveries.
findings.limitations: Register inspection is not independent verification of claims.
findings.relevance: Prevents duplicating and prematurely adopting peer work.

findings.title: GraphTP learns a task-specific sparse movie graph
findings.description: Publication defines movie summarization through turning-point scene identification with multimodal graph construction; semantic typed dependency transfer not established.
findings.limitations: Abstract and README only; no code audit or spontaneous-video validation.
findings.relevance: Candidate proposal architecture, not gold relationship labels.

findings.title: Separate retrieval, relation and dependency judgments
findings.description: Propose independent assessments of candidate evidence retrieval, typed relation grounding and necessity for interpretation/viewer.
findings.relevance: Prevents treating embedding similarity or KL sensitivity as truth.
